State EN: Same continuous hair tips are caught in the raised driver-window upper edge. Driver RIGHT hand approaches the single closed red scissors in her open lap bag.
狀態: 同一連續髮尾夾在升起的駕駛側窗上緣。駕駛右手靠近膝上開包內唯一合起紅剪刀。
Acting EN: Driver's brows draw together as her eyes track the taut hair tips and then the bag; concern without panic. Heroine watches the trapped strand neutrally. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 駕駛眉心輕皺，視線由拉緊髮尾移向包，擔心但不驚慌。女主中性地看被夾的髮束。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Driver RIGHT hand briefly holds CLOSED scissors at low chest height, well away from hair and face. Window stays raised and hair caught.
狀態: 駕駛右手短暫把合起剪刀拿至胸下，遠離頭髮與臉。車窗仍升起，頭髮仍被夾。
Acting EN: Driver studies closed scissors with earnest, over-serious concentration; heroine looks from scissors toward the door switch with one lightly raised brow, no smirk. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 駕駛過分認真地看合起剪刀。女主視線由剪刀移向車門開關，只輕挑一眉，不譏笑。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Closed scissors are already inside the lap bag; driver RIGHT may rest on their handles there. Heroine RIGHT index points from her own side toward the outboard switch without touching it or crossing the driver torso.
狀態: 合起剪刀已在膝上包內，駕駛右手可在包內搭其柄。女主右食指從自己一側指外側開關，不碰開關、不橫跨駕駛軀幹。
Acting EN: Driver's eyes follow the heroine's short pointing direction to the outboard switch; scissors are already in bag. Heroine's gaze targets the switch, mouth neutral. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 剪刀已回包，駕駛目光循女主短促指示看向外側開關。女主也看開關，嘴角中性。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Driver LEFT index visibly contacts the actual far-screen-right outboard rocker; the glass is still raised and hair still caught. Scissors stay in bag.
狀態: 駕駛左食指清楚接觸畫面最右外側真正翹板；玻璃仍升起、髮尾仍被夾。剪刀留包。
Acting EN: Driver concentrates on the actual rocker under her LEFT index; slight brow tension remains because hair is not free yet. Heroine watches the same control. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 駕駛集中看左食指下的真正翹板，髮尾尚未鬆開，所以眉心仍略繃。女主看同一開關。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Driver LEFT still presses the rocker. The same glass is descending and its top edge has cleared the same intact strand, which falls onto her shoulder; scissors remain in bag.
狀態: 駕駛左手仍按翹板；同一玻璃下降，上緣已離開同一完整髮束，髮束落回肩上。剪刀留包。
Acting EN: Driver's gaze follows the falling strand, eyebrows just starting to soften after release; no broad relief before the glass has moved. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 玻璃下降、髮束鬆開後，駕駛目光追隨落下的頭髮，眉心才開始舒展；之前不露大幅安心笑。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Window has reached halfway down and stopped. Driver LEFT hand checks the same free strand on her shoulder; heroine RIGHT point has retracted into her own space.
狀態: 車窗降至一半停住。駕駛左手查肩上同一自由髮束；女主右指已收回自己範圍。
Acting EN: Driver gently checks the freed intact strand, brow relaxed and shoulders less tense; heroine retracts her point into her own space with a calm face. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 駕駛輕查完整鬆開的髮束，眉心放鬆、肩膀不再繃。女主把指示手收回自己的空間，神情平靜。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Hair remains intact and free, window halfway down, unused closed scissors in the open lap bag. Neither person reaches across the center.
狀態: 頭髮保持完整自由、車窗半降，沒用上的合起剪刀在打開的膝上包內。沒人橫跨中央伸手。
Acting EN: Driver looks down at unused scissors in her lap bag, lips briefly pressed in mild embarrassment; heroine offers a tiny kind smile, not a laugh. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 駕駛低頭看包中沒用上的剪刀，短暫抿嘴、有點不好意思。女主輕輕友善微笑，不大笑。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Heroine joins exactly two empty flat palms at lower sternum and bows forward over her own lap. Window, free hair and bag contents stay unchanged.
狀態: 女主恰好兩隻空手在胸骨下方平貼合掌，朝自己膝上鞠躬。車窗、自由頭髮及包內物件不變。
Acting EN: Heroine's eyes soften in her small forward seated bow; driver looks down toward unused scissors in her lap bag while her LEFT hand gently touches the freed strand, with a settled sheepish smile and hands in her own space. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 女主小幅朝前坐姿鞠躬時眼神放柔；駕駛低眼看膝上包內未用剪刀，左手輕碰鬆開髮束，留淡淡尷尬笑，雙手留自己範圍。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。
